messages:
Lena (Sales): FYI — Greenwave Finance wants a POC. Requirements: SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, RBAC, domain lock, and they prefer Dedicated or Private options. Need checklist for presales + security questionnaire answers. Can we sync?

Omar (Solutions): I can take lead on the POC scope. Quick Q: do they need SP-init only or also IdP-init? That affects SAML flow we demo.

Lena (Sales): They said both for compatibility. Also want SCIM delta support and group sync for RBAC.

Omar (Solutions): Good. High-level POC steps: 1) Exchange SAML metadata, 2) SCIM attribute mapping + sample CSV, 3) RBAC role mapping doc, 4) domain verification (DNS TXT), 5) Dedicated capacity sizing & pricing. I'll draft templates.

Omar (Solutions): SCIM sample mapping snippet:
```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "{{user.email}}",
  "externalId": "{{user.id}}",
  "name": {"givenName": "{{user.givenName}}","familyName":"{{user.familyName}}"},
  "groups": ["engineering","sales"]
}
```

Jeff (Product): For Dedicated vs Private pricing: ballpark numbers to quote on call — Dedicated baseline (p3-equivalent pools) $25k–$40k/mo depending on throughput; Private (VPC + on-prem licensing) usually starts at $150k/year + infra. We'll refine after capacity numbers.

Lena (Sales): Can you put that in a slide with tiers? They'll ask for 95th pct latency and token QPS targets.

Sloane (Security): From security side — checklist items we need to answer: SOC2 report, encryption-at-rest (KMS/HSM), key access controls, audit log retention (90/365d options), SCIM over TLS, SAML metadata fingerprints, and data residency zones. Also confirm we support SCIM delta and rate-limits.

Omar (Solutions): We support SCIM incremental sync and bulk provisioning. Rate limits are configurable per-customer; will document expected throughput. For domain lock: we require a DNS TXT with provided token or an email-based verification if they control admin email.

Lena (Sales): They have an internal compliance questionnaire (70+ Qs). Who can own answers? Sloane for security, Jeff for architecture, legal for contracts.

Sloane (Security): I'll take the questionnaire for security sections. If anyone has recent SOC2 evidence or pen test summaries, drop in the shared drive link.

Omar (Solutions): I'll prepare SAML metadata template and a small demo script for IdP config. Example SP metadata snippet:
```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://api.redwood.example/metadata">
  <SPSSODescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://app.greenwave/callback"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

Lena (Sales): Great. Can we have a preflight call with Greenwave on Wednesday 10am PT? I'll ask them. Also need a one-page POC scope + success criteria (user sync working, SSO passing, role mapping validated, throughput within 95th pct SLA).

Jeff (Product): I'll drop a brief POC success criteria doc in the drive and a Dedicated sizing worksheet.

deploy-bot: POC ticket POC-4217 created and linked to Greenwave Finance (owners: Omar, Lena).

Lena (Sales): Thanks team. Next actions: Omar — share SAML/SCIM templates + runbook by EOD tomorrow. Sloane — start questionnaire answers. Jeff — pricing slide and sizing worksheet. I'll book the Wed call once Greenwave confirms.

Omar (Solutions): On it. Will post templates in #sales-presales and ping here when done. :thumbsup:
